supporting_reports.evidence: The autopilot disconnected and the aircraft reached a stall warning before the crew recovered.
The stick shaker activated and the aircraft descended 3,000 feet during the upset before control was regained.
The crew pitched down in response, reached an overspeed and lost significant altitude before recovering.

concerns: SAMPLE-016 shows unreliable airspeed with no upset; it fits SCF-NP rather than this LOC-I category.
